related.title: 雙偏振 QPSK：線速與淨資料率
related.titleEn: Dual-polarization QPSK: gross and net data rate
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學B不超75 GHz；0.10通過、0.25不通過；實際濾波尾端仍須額外量測。 rolloff.csv、頻譜支撐圖與窗長對照 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 70.4 與變更 80 GHz、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching bandwidth must not exceed75 GHz:0.10 passes and0.25 fails; real filter tails require separate measurement. rolloff.csv, spectral-support plot and window-length control Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 70.4 and changed 80 GHz, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學服務需至少120 Gbit/s；32 GBd組不足，40 GBd組達標但不代表光學誤碼已驗收。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching service requires120 Gbit/s;32 GBd is insufficient and40 GBd meets rate only, not optical BER acceptance.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成符號率64 GBd；滾降α由0.10改0.25；比較既定75 GHz頻槽。 名義式 (1+0.1)*64 = 70.4 GHz；變更式 (1+0.25)*64 = 80 GHz。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 由頻寬反算α；繪頻譜支撐區間與頻槽，不用FFT尖峰的位置代替整體占用頻寬。
合成32 GBd、有效負載比例0.80；變更至40 GBd而維持相同比例。 名義式 32*2*2*0.8 = 102.4 Gbit/s；變更式 40*2*2*0.8 = 128 Gbit/s。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 用1 ns時間窗列兩偏振符號數與編碼位元，再扣明示冗餘；以符號數守恆核對。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic symbol rate64 GBd; change roll-off from0.10 to0.25 against a75 GHz slot. Nominal (1+0.1)*64 = 70.4 GHz; changed (1+0.25)*64 = 80 GHz. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Recoverα from bandwidth and draw support intervals; FFT peak location is not occupied bandwidth.

Synthetic32 GBd and0.80 payload fraction; change to40 GBd with the same fraction. Nominal 32*2*2*0.8 = 102.4 Gbit/s; changed 40*2*2*0.8 = 128 Gbit/s. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Count symbols and coded bits on both polarizations in a1 ns window, then remove stated redundancy; reconcile symbol counts.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: GPON DBA：保證頻寬與剩餘授權
related.titleEn: GPON DBA: assured bandwidth and residual grants
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學B不超75 GHz；0.10通過、0.25不通過；實際濾波尾端仍須額外量測。 rolloff.csv、頻譜支撐圖與窗長對照 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 70.4 與變更 80 GHz、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching bandwidth must not exceed75 GHz:0.10 passes and0.25 fails; real filter tails require separate measurement. rolloff.csv, spectral-support plot and window-length control Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 70.4 and changed 80 GHz, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學保證量需全部保留且額外分配守恆；不能把1500/3000當整個ONU的總授權。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Preserve every assured allocation and conserve excess;1500/3000 are excess grants, not total ONU grants.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成符號率64 GBd；滾降α由0.10改0.25；比較既定75 GHz頻槽。 名義式 (1+0.1)*64 = 70.4 GHz；變更式 (1+0.25)*64 = 80 GHz。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 由頻寬反算α；繪頻譜支撐區間與頻槽，不用FFT尖峰的位置代替整體占用頻寬。

合成輪容量10000 bytes，4個ONU各保證1000；其餘6000等分給4個有需求ONU；變更只有2個有額外需求。 名義式 (10000-4*1000)/4 = 1500 extra bytes per active ONU；變更式 (10000-4*1000)/2 = 3000 extra bytes per active ONU。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 建立每ONU需求/保證/額外/總授權表，逐欄求和不超10000；零需求ONU不得拿走額外額度。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic symbol rate64 GBd; change roll-off from0.10 to0.25 against a75 GHz slot. Nominal (1+0.1)*64 = 70.4 GHz; changed (1+0.25)*64 = 80 GHz. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Recoverα from bandwidth and draw support intervals; FFT peak location is not occupied bandwidth.

Synthetic cycle capacity10000 bytes with four1000-byte assured grants; divide6000 excess equally among4, then2, active excess-demand ONUs. Nominal (10000-4*1000)/4 = 1500 extra bytes per active ONU; changed (10000-4*1000)/2 = 3000 extra bytes per active ONU. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Tabulate demand, assurance, excess and total grant per ONU; sum to at most10000 and give no excess to zero-demand ONUs.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
